stem: A suspected nutrient problem improves after correcting irrigation distribution without changing fertilizer concentration. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The original symptoms were at least partly related to root-zone water distribution or root function rather than simply insufficient fertilizer concentration
The fertilizer concentration must have changed by itself
The improvement proves all future symptoms have the same cause
rationale: Water distribution affects root-zone chemistry and root activity. Improvement after irrigation correction supports a root-zone contribution but should not be universalized to other cases.
